question: What was the median cycle time by region for claims reported in Q1 2025?

report.interpretation: Median days from report date to close date, for closed claims only, grouped by region. Claims are selected by report date from 2025-01-01 to 2025-03-31, using the agreed cycle_time_days metric.
report.answer: Median cycle time for Q1 2025 reported claims: California 25 days, North 25 days, Southeast 23 days, Texas 23 days. Q1 2025 is well in the past, so late reporting doesn't distort these figures. Only closed claims count, so any claims still open are excluded.
report.answer_sql: WITH source AS (SELECT c.*, c.close_date - c.report_date AS days_to_close FROM claims c) SELECT region, median(days_to_close) FILTER (WHERE status = 'closed') AS median_cycle_time_days FROM source WHERE report_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND report_date <= DATE '2025-03-31' GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

tool_calls.sql:
WITH source AS (
    SELECT c.*, p.channel, p.metro,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) AS paid_to_date,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) + c.reserve_amount AS incurred,
           c.close_date - c.report_date AS days_to_close
    FROM claims c
    JOIN policies p USING (policy_id)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) AS paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id
    ) pay USING (claim_id)
)
SELECT region, median(days_to_close) FILTER (WHERE status = 'closed') AS value
FROM source
WHERE report_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND report_date <= DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY ALL
